confidence_notes: Overall low confidence. Food and drink anchors rest on sparse, partly undated 2025-2026 El Calafate menu and guide snippets that conflict. Peso prices were converted at about ARS 1,510 per USD, the late-July 2026 BNA retail rate from news search results; the RBA rate is USD/AUD and was not used for this. Beer assumes a roughly 0.5 L draft pour. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are the best supported; the two-person mid-range figure excludes drinks. Cocktail and wine_glass have no direct 2026 bar prices and are inferred from the beer anchor (cocktail about 1.75x beer, wine glass about 1.6x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July, mid-season window; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked, so they are the least certain values.
comparable_city_reasoning: No named comparable city. Food and drink anchors use El Calafate-specific price snippets. Accommodation anchors use general knowledge of Patagonian tourist-hub pricing (El Calafate and similar Santa Cruz and Patagonia towns), where hotel rates are often quoted in USD.
